dct_description_sm:
These sites are part of the Etobicoke Creek Watershed Plan (ECWP) work for erosion characterization which relies on fluvial geomorphological data. Fluvial data was collected at these sites and used to characterize the corresponding reaches in Etobicoke Creek.
For future scenario analysis, data was collected at the fluvial sites to inform erosion risk, then aggregated at the subwatershed scale. 
The Label attribute column is the name of the fluvial monitoring site.
